architecture: Exactly the same frozen19 utility coefficients and one bounded context coefficient. Same three fixed feature hypotheses; no added feature or price-score parameter.
eta_fitting: Treat eta as a fitted scalar. For each underlying TRAINING model, fit eta on that training partition's available size labels. Preserve every baseline-correct labeled meaningful training case. Also satisfy directly supported negative training cases that are reachable with eta<=1 when jointly feasible; if constraints conflict, record it and minimize unmet reachable anchors without sacrificing meaningful cases. Choose best materiality balance, fewer false calls, smallest eta.
nested_validation: Use cached underlying inner TRAINING fits. Fit eta inside each inner training partition and evaluate on its held-out families. Select only the context kind from these inner out-of-fold results; then fit eta on full outer training rows. This avoids the calibration-to-full-fit mismatch. Outer labels are never used in either step.
delivery: Require fewer false calls than improved v17 and no more than v16; balanced materiality at least both; all directions unchanged; directly supported materiality and meaningful recall at least improved v17; overall meaningful recall at least v16. Preserve corrected Round36 outcomes. Any proxy-recall tradeoff must be reported. The two models are alternative bounded1-parameter hypotheses, not causal identification.
scope: Same v18 data, original paired-fold assignments and utility fits. No data relabeling or questionnaire. Initial calibration experiment and all old baselines remain unchanged. Small known-label training consistency is not prospective performance.
